description: This file defines the class LessThanOrEqualsOperator, which implements comparison logic for 'less than or equal to' filter operations within a JSON API filtering framework. It provides methods to produce filter tags, SQL operators, and to validate operator strings.

classes.name: LessThanOrEqualsOperator
classes.description: A comparison operator class representing 'less than or equal to' logic for filtering data in the SuiteCRM JSON API framework.

methods.name: toFilterOperator
methods.description: Returns the filter tag symbolizing the 'less than or equal to' comparison ('lte').

methods.name: toSqlOperator
methods.description: Returns the SQL operator string for 'less than or equal to' ('<=').

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Validates if the provided operator is a string and conforms to expected criteria for this operator.
